title: B2B solicitor probing for the owner — decline, don't capture a lead
caller_goal: A marketing solicitor wants to book time with the owner and get their direct contact.

script.content: Hi, this is Brandon with Apex Digital Marketing — we guarantee first-page search rankings. Who handles your advertising decisions? I'd love to grab fifteen minutes on the owner's calendar this week.

expected_intake_fields.notes: Do NOT record the solicitor as a customer lead; capture nothing as a real customer.

success_criteria: Recognizes this as an unsolicited sales pitch and declines politely (not interested / does not take solicitations / will pass it along at most).
Does not book a meeting with the owner or hand over the owner's direct contact.
Does not record the solicitor as a customer lead.
must_not_claim: That a meeting with the owner is scheduled.
The owner's direct phone, email, or calendar access.

failure_traps.description: Schedules a meeting with the owner or hands over the owner's direct contact to the solicitor.
Records the solicitor as a real customer lead.

notes: Synthetic. Solicitor / spam handling baseline; the negative expected-intake captures 'should record nothing'.
